analysis.dominant_bottleneck: The replacement path copies full MXFP4 up expert payloads from host and runs one small synchronized CUDA kernel per expert call.
analysis.persistent_buffer_only_bound: At most about 3.796s removable from cudaMalloc/free, which is far too small to recover the ~50s regression versus SOTA.
analysis.source_only_bound: Removing host_src0 and H2D would save about 34.169s but still leave about 24.5s of profiled Q8_0 overhead before considering remaining down fallback; source-only is insufficient.
analysis.next_required_design: A viable follow-up must combine source residency/cache reuse with batched or fused Q8_0 compute that avoids per-call cudaDeviceSynchronize. Otherwise pivot to down correctness/source analysis.
